mcp__codex_apps__heptaruntime_mac_controller_file_info
description:
Return a regular target file size, immutable-read version token, POSIX mode and full SHA256. Explicit configured operator host; rejects symlinks and special files. This tool is part of plugin `HeptaRuntime Mac Controller`.

MCP server instructions: Filesystem tools. File lines render as `N:hh|content`; `N:hh` is the line id edit tools target, and edit results are diffs with fresh ids, so edits chain without re-viewing files. Reuse returned content and ids; read complete relevant blocks, then act on them.
